newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Dec 17 - Santa Fe - One vessel berthed loading wheat. No vessels in roads, no vessels due. Max. recommended draft 28 ft. 2 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 28 ft. 3 in. at passage km. 520. San Lorenzo - Five vessels berthed of which 2 loading sbmp, 1 loading sbm, 1 loading wheat, 1 loading by-products. 5 Vessels in roads, 23 due at 9 terminals during the coming week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary in the next week. Pasa berth - Draft 23 Ft. 5 in. fw.

Rosario - Nine vessels berthed of which 3 awaiting orders, 1 loading sugar, 3 loading wheat, 2 loading maize. 2 Vessels in roads, 12 due during the coming week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary in the next week. Villa Constitucion - One vessel berthed discharging wrc. No vessels in roads, 2 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. fw. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - Three vessels berthed of which 1 loading steel products, 2 loading wheat. No vessels in roads, 10 due during the week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel.

San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Max. recommendable draft for Mitre Channel at high tide is as follows, vessels up to 22 metres beam 32 ft/fw (high tide), vessels over 22 metres beam, 31 ft 6 in./fw (high tide). Buenos Aires - 20 vessels in port, 30 due during coming week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft 6 in fw high tide Naabsa (guided by Entrance channel. Buenos Aires dock sud max. recommended draft 29 ft. fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by Entrance channel). Necochea - Two vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 loading sfmp. No vessels in roads, two due during the coming week. Max. draft 40 ft fw. Bahia Blanca - Four vessels berthed of which 2 loading wheat, 1 loading naphtha, 1 loading ethylene. No vessels in roads, 16 due during the coming week. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, Dec 17 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 3 granite loaders, 1 bulk malt discharger, 1 bulk wheat discharger. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 2 Steel plates loaders, 2 coal dischargers. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. Ubu - 1 Iron ore loader. 12 vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Vessels berthed, 5 full containers, 5 general cargo, 1 bulk cement discharger, 6 sugar loaders, 3 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 bulk chemical products discharger, 1 bulk chemical products loader, 1 sulphur discharger, 1 diesel oil discharger, 1 iron ore loader, 1 reefer discharger. 4 Vessels waiting in roads. 78 Vessels due during next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Iron ore discharger, 1 steel products loader. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed - 1 Fl container, 1 soya discharger, 1 wheat discharger. No vessels waiting in roads, 11 due during next 10 days. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 2 general cargo/steel products dischargers, 2 container dischargers, 2 general cargo dischargers, 1 paper discharger, 1 passenger, 1 wheat discharger, 1 salt discharger. 2 Steel products loaders, 1 general cargo/steel products, 1 sugar loader. Tecon - 2 Vessels. 33 vessels due during next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 3 Vessels berthed. Commercial quay - 1 Vessel berthed, one waiting in roads, five due during next 7 days. Paranagua - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo, 2 fertiliser dischargers, 1 reefer discharger. 1 Sugar loader, 2 general cargo loaders, 2 reefer loaders. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 reefer loader, 1 fertiliser discharger, 1 general cargo discharger. 30 Vessels due during next 7 days.

CHILE, Dec 16 - Arica - Two vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant. 6 Vessels due during the week. Iquique - Four vessels operating, 2 berths vacant, 9 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Two vessels berthed, 4 berths available. 5 Vessels due during the week to load and discharge concentrates, copper bulk, containers and general cargo. No vessels in roads. Valparaiso - Four vessels berthed, working normally. 5 Berths vacant, 1 berth out of service due to enlargement of pier 3 until April 1997. 19 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Six vessels operating, 2 berths vacant, 14 vessels due during the week, port busy but no waiting time.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - No vessels at terminal, 3 due this week, none in roads. Savicente - Three vessels berthed, working normally, no berths vacant, no vessels in roads. 4 Vessels due during the week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - 1 Vessel berthed. Steel pier - No vessels, 1 berth vacant. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, 1 due during the week. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel due this week. Lirquen - No vessels berthed - 6 Berths vacant, 2 vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels. Puerto Montt - Two vessels berthed of which 1 coaster, 1 commercial vessel. No vessels in roads. Punta Arenas - Two vessels and 1 coaster berthed, 5 vessels and coasters, 1 commercial vessel. 1 Passenger vessel due during the week, no vessels in roads.

PERU, Dec 16 - Callao - Three vessels in bay, 6 in pier (general cargo/containers), no berthing delays. Paita - Two frozen cargo vessels in pier, no berthing delays. Chimbote - Two vessels in bay, 1 in pier (fishmeal)/ no berthing delays. Talara - One vessel in bay, 1 in pier (oil), no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco, Ilo - No vessels.

VENEZUELA, Dec 16 - Puerto Cabello - Two vessels anchored. 16 Berthed of which 4 grain cargo, 2 bulk cargo, 1 ro/ro, 4 containers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - Four vessels anchored/ no vessels berthed.
